items.title: PDPO Compliance
items.description: We fully comply with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO) of Hong Kong, which governs how personal data is handled.

items.title: Cross-Border Data Compliance
items.description: As a Hong Kong-registered entity processing data submitted by clients operating across multiple jurisdictions, SneakersLite's data handling practices align with:
items.conclusion: Client data submitted via API is processed solely for authentication purposes. Cross-border data transfers are conducted in accordance with applicable legal requirements in each operating jurisdiction.

items.title: Data Ownership & Usage
items.description: Clients retain full ownership of all images and authentication reports submitted through the SneakersLite API. Submitted data is used exclusively for:
points: Anonymised model training to improve authentication accuracy (with client consent per service agreement)
items.conclusion: Client data is never sold, disclosed to third parties, or used outside the scope of the contracted service.
